source_frame: Node admission set: claims about the REQUESTING endpoint, not the workload. D1.3 pairs every workload with an AIWorkloadID and a NodeID; these claims gate the NodeID side. Health values arrive as the node's own self-report, which is upstream origin by definition, so a healthy-sounding self-report earns REVIEW, not PASS, until a controller-measured or hardware-attested source exists.

claims.statement: Node integrity self-test passed on the requesting endpoint
Requesting endpoint patch age stays under 30 days
